opening.evidence: common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:41 on_game_start_country fires hidden toxoids.7000 (events/toxoids_events.txt:576-633: starts situation_toxic_knights and turns a nearby barren/molten/toxic planet into a molten world with alloy and energy deposits). Keep branches: hidden 8014 (monthly common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:343, events/toxoids_events.txt:3423-3476), hidden 8016 (planet destroyed, common/on_actions/01_planet_destruction.txt:16/39, 02_component_on_actions.txt:249/277), hidden 8018/8019 (arkship), hidden 8024 (planet regained); 8030 is fired by nomads.4705 arkship_settle_planet_effect for the knights homeworld.

label.zh: 骑士团舰队进入毒圣星系且毒圣仍在
label.en: A knights fleet enters the Toxic God system while the entity is still there

bridges.evidence: events/toxoids_events.txt:2735-2759 7310 fires from on_entering_system_fleet (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1044) when the system has star flag guardian_toxic_god_system, the controller has the origin and the original entity fleet is present.

label.zh: 非骑士团帝国的舰队进入毒圣星系
label.en: A fleet of another empire enters the Toxic God system

bridges.evidence: events/toxoids_events.txt:2789-2812 7311 (controller without the origin, entity present).

label.zh: 骑士团舰队进入毒圣星系，但毒圣已被消灭或离开
label.en: A knights fleet enters the system but the entity is gone or killed

bridges.evidence: events/toxoids_events.txt:2827-2853 7312 (global flag toxic_god_killed or no toxic_god_original_fleet).

events/toxoids_events.txt:2891-2905 7315 fires from on_ship_destroyed_perp (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1468) when the destroyed ship belongs to country type guardian_toxic_god and the killer has the origin.

label.en: The Toxic God is destroyed by another empire

bridges.evidence: events/toxoids_events.txt:3075-3109 7515 fires from on_fleet_destroyed_perp (common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:1662); sets global flag toxic_god_killed.

label.en: What awaits in the sealed system

note.zh: 取决于进入者是否为骑士团起源、毒圣是否仍在。
note.en: Depends on whether the visitor has the origin and whether the entity is still present.

note.zh: 骑士团帝国得到“驯服/终结”的选择（7315）；其他帝国直接得到遗物（7515）。
note.en: A knights empire chooses to tame or finish it (7315); other empires just receive the relic (7515).

note.zh: 局势每月随机列表：8000与8005各10，其余1200为无事（约1.6%/月）。
note.en: Monthly random list of the situation: 8000 and 8005 weight 10 each against 1200 for nothing (common/situations/01_toxoid_situations.txt:318-327).

note.zh: 驯服毒圣后900天。
note.en: 900 days after taming the entity.

note.zh: 获得遗物 r_toxic_god，之后触发 8020。
note.en: Grants the relic r_toxic_god; 8020 follows.

note.zh: 任务完成；若有宇宙起源飞升则有额外选项。
note.en: Quest complete; an extra option exists with Cosmogenesis.

note.zh: 局势被销毁，任务结束。
note.en: The situation is destroyed and the quest ends.

notes.zh: 与骗术师的对决：若第四传说中选择了黑骑士路线（旗标 toxoids_7095_b），骑士力挽狂澜；否则传奇骑士身亡，帝国受诅咒900天。
notes.en: Fight with the Trickster: with the Sable Knights choice of 7095.b the knights save the day, otherwise a legend dies and the empire is cursed for 900 days (events/toxoids_events.txt:2619-2658).

notes.zh: 局势进度0–1000共8个阶段（每阶段125）；阶段2–8首次进入时依次触发隐藏事件 7005/7020/7050/7075/7110/7140/7195，各开启一段“骑士传说”。每月基础进度+0.4（受方针、政策、骑士岗位和士气影响）。完成后 7250 → 7255。
notes.en: Progress 0-1000 in eight stages of 125. Entering stages 2-8 fires hidden 7005/7020/7050/7075/7110/7140/7195, each opening one knight tale. Base progress +0.4 a month, modified by approach, policy, knight jobs and morale (common/situations/01_toxoid_situations.txt:192-365). Completion fires 7250 -> 7255.

notes.zh: 打开通往封印星系的超空间航道：生成毒圣星系（隐藏 7500）、开启“毒圣：位置”事件链与兴趣点，并销毁局势。
notes.en: Opens the hyperlane to the sealed system: hidden 7500 spawns the Toxic God system, the finisher event chain and POI start, and the situation is destroyed (events/toxoids_events.txt:2660-2731).

notes.zh: 游戏满100年且尚未触发时出现；可办庆典、置之不理或解散骑士团（销毁局势）。
notes.en: Fires once after 100 years of game time; festival, ignore, or disband the order for a payout (destroys the situation) (events/toxoids_events.txt:3335-3419).

uncertain: Tales 7006-7225 are shown as read in the compiled tree: each quest starts when the situation enters its stage, so tales can overlap in play; the compiler chains the stage events (ledger R5).
Option-level details of the middle tales (7055-7165, 7195-7225) were taken from the compiled tree rather than re-read line by line.
